subject: Quintel security questionnaire & SOC 2 package - delivery plan
messages:
From: Linda Hart <linda.hart@quintel.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com, procurement@quintel.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 package (Quintel RFP)

Hi Sean and team,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week — the folks here at Quintel were impressed with the low-latency demos. Our procurement team is collecting the security/compliance packages for the RFP and we'd like to confirm timelines. Specifically we need: 1) completed SIG questionnaire (focused on data handling and vendor assurances), 2) the latest SOC 2 Type II report, and 3) a mapping grid that ties your security controls to our SIG questions and to SOC 2 controls.

Can you confirm what you can provide by Aug 20 and whether any items will be redacted or need an NDA? Also please include contacts for on-call reviewers if we have follow-ups.

Appreciate it — Linda Hart
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Quintel Systems

Attachments: Quintel_RFP_SecurityChecklist.xlsx (procurement template)

From: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-16T10:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 package (Quintel RFP)

Team — forwarding Quintel's ask. Short plan proposal:

- Marissa: can you lead the SIG mapping? If you can produce a populated mapping for the procurement template by EOD Aug 18 that would let us run a quick quality pass and redact anything sensitive.
- Neha: please pull the latest SOC 2 Type II report and confirm if we need a redacted copy or full artifact (we usually share a redacted PDF for RFPs). Target: SOC2 file to me by Aug 18.
- Markus: coordinate with product/infra for any clarifications around data residency and key management statements — Quintel is US-based; call out any regions that might affect answers.

I'll own the client-facing email and the NDA question. If anything looks like a legal risk, flag it immediately.

Thanks — Sean
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: (none)

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-08-17T15:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 package (Quintel RFP)

Sean / Neha — attached is the first-pass SIG mapping I built against Quintel's template. I focused sections on: data classification, encryption in transit / at rest, key rotation, access control & provisioning, incident response, and subcontractor vetting. Notes:

- Items highlighted in yellow are 'requires infra input' (I asked Markus for those specifics).
- Where Quintel's template asked for 'sample evidence' I linked to internal doc IDs; for the external deliverable I'll extract exported PDFs.
- For controls where we rely on cloud provider guarantees we call out the provider and the exact contractual point.

I've also drafted language around our SOC 2 sharing policy — we provide a redacted Type II PDF for RFPs unless a signed NDA is in place; full reports are only shared under a mutual NDA and for limited reviewers.

Attachments: control_mapping_SIG_partial.xlsx (draft), SIG_mapping_notes.txt (internal comments)

I'll iterate after Markus's infra notes.

— Marissa
Principal Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
To: Linda Hart <linda.hart@quintel.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-08-18T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 package (Quintel RFP)

Hi Linda — thanks for the clear ask. Please find below what we are sending and next steps.

1) SIG questionnaire mapping: attached is our completed mapping (draft) that answers Quintel's template questions and references the relevant control evidence. It includes callouts where we need to provide exported PDFs versus internal drive links.
2) SOC 2 Type II: attached is a redacted PDF of our SOC 2 report (SOC2_report_2026-09.pdf). As standard, full unredacted reports require a mutual NDA.
3) Supplemental controls spreadsheet: control_mapping_SIG_partial.xlsx (contains mapping to SOC 2 criteria and quick notes on evidence locations).

Related links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aB2cExampleLink/view?usp=sharing (secure folder with exported artifacts).

Next steps / asks for Quintel:
- Please confirm if the redacted SOC 2 PDF is sufficient for procurement screening or if you require an NDA to view the full report.
- If there are any SIG items marked "requires infra input" please list the question numbers so we can prioritize follow-ups.
- Let us know the expected review timeline — we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our security team next week if helpful.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_RFP_Response_v1.pdf (cover note + instructions), SOC2_report_2026-09.pdf (redacted), control_mapping_SIG_partial.xlsx

If you want to hand this off to a reviewer, please loop them in and we'll provide the Drive access link with viewer privileges.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Linda Hart <linda.hart@quintel.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@quintel.com
Date: 2027-08-20T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 package (Quintel RFP)

Sean — got the package, thank you. SOC2 redacted PDF and the mapping spreadsheet look good at first glance. A couple of quick follow-ups from our side:

- SIG Q14 (data retention): can you confirm whether logs tied to customer data are retained for longer than 90 days by default? If so, please note the retention configuration options.
- For KMS key management: do you manage keys centrally in our region or use cloud provider-managed keys? We need a one-line statement to include in the RFP response.

If you can send the two clarifications by EOD Aug 22 we'll complete the procurement review. Also please include the HubSpot record id if you'd like us to link the vendor file.

Thanks — Linda
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Quintel Systems
